column1: # Hand-checked successors of the old names the generated map cannot pair (macros, anonymous enums,
# renamed types whose fields changed too), looked up in the new decomp by value or expansion.

column4: evidence. An empty new: removed (see the evidence); a new that is not a name: no rename.

same value 2 (now documented: random pick among true conditions)

same bytes, ARGS REORDERED: (type, textId, tf) -> (type, tf, textId)

same value 0; ChannelUpdateType was merged into AudioThreadCmdOp (channel opcodes 0x00-0x0E)
same value 1; same switch case in src/audio/internal/thread.c

same value 0; SurfaceSfxType became SurfaceMaterial (SurfaceType_GetSfxType -> SurfaceType_GetMaterial)
same 14+MAX enum. Do not confuse with the new SurfaceSfxOffset enum (a different, 16-member enum used by SurfaceType_GetSfxOffset)
same fields (u16 type -> seqPlayer, startFrame, endFrame); now a union padded to 0x30 (s32 _words[12]), was a 0x6 struct
same fields (u8 unk_00, u8 sequence -> seqIdPlusOne, ...); union padded to 0x30. The same layout is also used for stop-seq as CsCmdStopSeq

same fields (u8 unk_00, u8 setting -> settingPlusOne, ...); union padded to 0x30
same command; now written as -1 (comment 0xFFFF) instead of 0xFFFF

same words: cmd 0x0001, CMD_HH(0x0001, startFrame), CMD_HH(endFrame, 0). Do not use new CS_CAM_EYE (cmd 0x0007, single point)
no hardcoded 0x3AA0 now: size comes from the build-generated assets/audio/soundfont_sizes.h, summed into SFX_SOUNDFONTS_SIZE; first of the two, by order. File is session_init.c, not session_config.c

removed: the string-literal form ("\x02") is gone; HIGHSCORE(HS_FISHING) with the HighScores enum (value 2)
same layout, size 0x98, all offsets match (TargetContextEntry -> LockOnReticle; e.g. targetedActor -> reticleActor, arrowPointedActor -> naviHoverActor, unk_94 -> arrowHoverActor)
same command word (op 0x0), but ARGS CHANGED: (p, fade, seqId) -> (p, fadeInDuration, seqArg, seqId); old put seqArg in the high byte of the u16 seqId, now a separate arg (usually 0)
same word 0xB0004000 | p<<24 | dur<<16; ARGS CHANGED: the old 3rd arg (always 0) is dropped: (p, duration)
same word 0x70000000 | p<<24 | port<<16 | (u8)data; same arg order

removed: the generic setup-command macro (op 0xC; a = subOp<<4 | targetPlayer) was split into SEQCMD_SETUP_* macros, one per sub-op (e.g. 0x30 -> SEQCMD_SETUP_SCALE_TEMPO, 0xA0 -> SEQCMD_SETUP_SET_SEQPLAYER_FREQ, 0x8x -> SEQCMD_SETUP_RESTORE_SEQPLAYER_VOLUME_WITH_SCALE_INDEX, 0x9x -> SEQCMD_SETUP_SET_CHANNEL_DISABLE_MASK)

removed: generic tempo macro (op 0xB; b = subOp<<4) split into SEQCMD_SET_TEMPO / SPEED_UP_TEMPO / SLOW_DOWN_TEMPO / SCALE_TEMPO / RESET_TEMPO. Only old use, Audio_SeqCmdB(BGM_MAIN, 5, 0, 0xD2), is now SEQCMD_SET_TEMPO(BGM_MAIN, 5, 210)
same word (op 0x6), ARGS REORDERED: old (p, duration, channel, vol) -> new (p, channelIndex, duration, volume)
same word 0xE0000000 | (u8)mode; ARGS CHANGED: playerIdx dropped (old callers passed BGM_MAIN = 0, so the word is the same)
same word 0xE0000100 | value; ARGS CHANGED: playerIdx dropped (old callers passed BGM_MAIN = 0)
same word (op 0x8), ARGS REORDERED: old (p, ioPort, channel, data) -> new (p, channelIndex, ioPort, ioData)
same audio-thread cmd: op 0x83, player<<16, s32 fadeOut (an AudioThread cmd, not a SEQCMD); same args
same expansion: Audio_ProcessSeqCmd(op 4 | p<<24 | dur<<16 | (u8)(vol*127)); still local to the file, not in seqcmd.h
same word (op 0x3), ARGS CHANGED: (p, seqId) -> (p, fadeOutInDuration, seqId); old use is now SEQCMD_UNQUEUE_SEQUENCE(p, 0, seqId)
removed: inlined as waterBox->properties & 0xFF in WaterBox_GetBgCamIndex; packing is now WATERBOX_PROPERTIES(bgCamIndex, lightIndex, roomIndex, isDisabled) in include/bgcheck.h
same expansion ((vI) & (((flags) & 7) << 13)); same call sites in z_bgcheck.c
same expansion { x, CAM_DATA_FLAGS } -> { x, CAM_DATA_INTERFACE_FIELD } (enum value 0x09, renamed)
same float value (3.40282347e+38f, the old long literal rounds to the same f32), same position
same arithmetic, addr - 0x80000000 (cast now (u32) via char*); z_actor.c gSegments[6] = OS_K0_TO_PHYSICAL(...); PHYSICAL_TO_VIRTUAL is gone too (SEGMENTED_TO_VIRTUAL adds K0BASE)
